justification: The only shared depicted content is generic: a circular disc-like motif and sweeping curved bands rendered in shallow relief on a tall surface, which any tradition could produce independently. B depicts a specific figural scene \u2014 a bird-headed winged anthropomorph in profile holding a bucket beside a stylised rosette-laden tree with a horizontal inscription band \u2014 while A shows only abstract geometric elements (a ring, arcs, a girdle-like band) with no figures, animals or vegetal motifs at all.
